Demo Payments API Reference

# Demo Payments API

Fictional API used for a monitoring tutorial. Version 1.

## Authentication

Send your secret key in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token on every request.

## POST `/payments`

Creates a payment for a customer.

### Request body

Parameter

Type

Required

Description

`customer_id`

string

Required

ID of the customer who pays.

`amount`

integer

Required

Amount in the smallest currency unit, for example cents.

`currency`

string

Required

Three-letter ISO currency code, for example `usd`.

`description`

string

Optional

Text shown on the receipt.

### Example request

curl -X POST https://api.demo-payments.example/payments \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO\_PAYMENTS\_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"customer\_id": "cus\_123", "amount": 2500, "currency": "usd"}'

### Response

Returns `201 Created` with the new payment object.
